description: Students investigate a specific topic in dance through
lecture, readings, class discussions, the viewing of live and recorded dance, physical practice,
Potential topics could include dance and social justice, politics and the
performing arts, dance and gender, dance and anthropology, dance aesthetics, dance/movement
therapy, and ethics. Topics vary from term to term.
May be repeated if topic is different. Offered
periodically. Prerequisite: No required prerequisites but it is recommended that students taking
this course have previous experience in a dance language intensive course.
